title: Cohomology properties of maps in (Cat) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: A is a small category (a test category in the sense of Pursuing Stacks) and A^ is the category of presheaves on A. W_A is the class of 'homotopismes': maps of presheaves u such that i_A(u) (equivalently the induced functor on categories of elements A/X -> A/X') is a weak equivalence in (Cat). Hot_A is the corresponding homotopy category.

Corollary (page renumbered 5, formerly 4). Let \bar{A^} be the localization of A^ by W_A, so that Hot_A ≃ W_A^{-1} A^. Grothendieck claims that W_A 'permet un calcul des fractions'.

He checks the Ore-type axiom first. Given an arrow i: Y -> X and g: Y -> Y' in W_A, one must complete them to a commutative square f∘i = i'∘g with f: X -> X' in W_A.
- A plain pushout fails. The previous page shows explicitly, with a suspension/cone counterexample in (Cat), that pushouts along arbitrary maps (even immersions in Cat) do not preserve W.
- He therefore factors i as Y --i'--> X_1 --h--> X. Here i' is a monomorphism ('immersion'), built from a cylinder X×I (mapping-cylinder construction, 'cf plus bas'), and h is a homotopism.
- He then pushes g out along the mono i'. This uses the fact that pushouts of homotopisms along monomorphisms of presheaves are homotopisms (left properness).

The page breaks off at 'D'autre part, on ... que'. The next page treats the second axiom: cancellation, i.e. given f∘s = g∘s with s in W_A (s mono), find t in W_A with t∘f = t∘g. It then abstracts the needed input into axioms on a class M of 'cofibrations':
- (i) factorization into an M-map followed by a homotopism;
- (ii) pushouts of W-maps along M-maps are in W;
- (iii) a generating family of intervals I_α with X⊔X -> X×I_α in M ('ce sont donc des intervalles séparants');
- (iv) stability of W under coproducts.
This is essentially a left-proper cofibration-category / Cisinski-style axiomatics of an A-localizer.

The margin note reads roughly 'Il faut que W_A soit [catégoriquement?] local' and 'itou dans Hot / (Cat)'. It apparently records that the argument requires a locality or saturation property of W_A, and that the same should be done for Cat.
errors: As literally stated, the claim that W_A admits a (Gabriel–Zisman) calculus of left fractions is false in general. Counterexample in simplicial sets (A = Δ): let Y = Δ^1, X = Δ^1/∂Δ^1 (a simplicial circle), i the quotient map, Y' = point, g: Δ^1 -> pt (a weak equivalence). Any commutative square forces f to factor through the pushout X ∪_Y pt = pt, so f cannot be a weak equivalence.

The factorization argument does not close the square on X. It produces X_1 -> X_1 ∪_Y Y' in W together with h: X_1 -> X in W, i.e. a zigzag rather than the required square. What it does prove is the weaker 'homotopical' calculus of fractions: every morphism of Hot_A is represented by a cospan X -> X'' <- Y with the backward arrow in W (Brown/Waldhausen-style, for left proper cofibration categories). It does not give the strict Ore condition.

The cancellation axiom treated on the next page likewise holds only up to homotopy in general, not strictly. Grothendieck's own marginal remark that W_A must satisfy an extra locality/saturation condition, and his reformulation into axioms (i)-(iv), suggest he sensed the gap.

ideas.what: Hot_A presented as the localization W_A^{-1} A^ of presheaves on a test category by homotopisms
ideas.modern_name: homotopy category of the Cisinski/Grothendieck model structure on presheaves (A-localizer)

ideas.what: Attempt to prove a calculus of fractions for W_A by factoring a map through a cylinder into a monomorphism followed by a homotopism, then pushing out along the mono (left properness)
ideas.modern_name: homotopy calculus of fractions in a left proper cofibration category (Brown's factorization lemma, dual)
ideas.usually_credited_to: K. S. Brown (1973), Waldhausen, Cisinski ('Catégories dérivables'), Rădulescu-Banu
ideas.where_published: Pursuing Stacks discusses related asphericity and pushout properties; not sure this exact argument appears

ideas.what: Abstract axioms (on the next page) for a class M of cofibrations with separating intervals ensuring good localization
ideas.modern_name: separating intervals / homotopical structure on a presheaf category, A-localizers
ideas.where_published: Pursuing Stacks (intervals, 'séparant'); worked out by Cisinski

deep.surprise_reason: This is a draft attempt to show that weak equivalences of presheaves admit a calculus of fractions, using cylinder factorization and left properness. The idea is standard (Brown, Cisinski), and the strict claim is actually false; Grothendieck's own margin and next page show him reformulating it. The axiomatics with separating intervals anticipates Cisinski but is already credited via Pursuing Stacks.
transcription_corrections: Top: page number '5' with an earlier '4' (and an illegible number) struck out on the left.

The arrow line is better read as 'Soit une flèche Y --i--> X, [et] g: Y -> Y' ∈ W_A', with 'des A^' inserted above. X was overwritten by Y in the diagram, so the square is Y -> X, g: Y -> Y', f: X -> X', i': Y' -> X'.

Factorization line: 'On va factoriser i en Y --i'--> X_1 --h--> X', where i' is presumably a monomorphism/immersion, followed by '(mapping cylinder) Mor(X×I)?? (cf plus bas)' and '... h homotopisme ... i' immersion ... X' ... cocartésien'.
Left margin reads approximately 'Il faut que W_A soit [catégoriquement] local' and 'itou dans Hot / (Cat)'. The machine reading 'Il faut ... A sont tous loc.' is uncertain.
